subject: ela
skillName: Compare two texts on same topic
intro: Two fact books can be about the same topic. We can see how they are the same (alike) and different (not alike). Kindergartners find one way two texts are alike or not.

items.prompt:
Book 1 and Book 2 are both about dogs. Book 1 tells about big dogs. Book 2 tells about small dogs.

How are the books the SAME?

steps: So they are the same because both are about dogs.

items.prompt:
Book 1 shows a photo of a cat. Book 2 shows a drawing of a cat.

How are they DIFFERENT?

steps: One has a photo, one has a drawing.
So they are different in their pictures.
solution.answer: One has a photo and one has a drawing.

items.prompt: Both books tell facts about the sun. Name one way they are the SAME.

steps: Both tell facts about the sun.
So one way they are the same is both are about the sun.

items.prompt: Two books are both about trucks. How are they the same?
